function.name: audit_log_trigger
function.description: Track all data changes for compliance and debugging
function.trigger: AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON [sensitive_tables]
function.body: INSERT INTO audit_logs (table_name, record_id, action, old_data, new_data, user_id, ip_address, timestamp) VALUES ( TG_TABLE_NAME, COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id), TG_OP, CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN row_to_json(OLD) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN row_to_json(NEW) ELSE NULL END, auth.uid(), current_setting('request.headers', true)::json->>'x-forwarded-for', NOW() ); RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);

function.name: soft_delete

function.body: UPDATE [table_name] SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = OLD.id; RETURN NULL; -- Prevents actual deletion

module.name: authentication
module.description: Authentication is handled by Supabase Auth. Frontend uses Supabase Auth UI or custom forms. Backend verifies JWT tokens from Supabase.

endpoint.description: Register a new user with email/phone and password
endpoint.logic: - Call supabase.auth.signUp() with email/phone and password - For email: sends confirmation email automatically - For phone: sends OTP via Supabase's SMS provider - User record auto-created in public.users via database trigger

endpoint.description: Sign in with email/phone and password
endpoint.logic: - Call supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() - Return session tokens for frontend storage - Fetch user profile from public.users table
- Call supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ phone }) - Supabase sends OTP via configured SMS provider

endpoint.description: Verify phone OTP and complete sign in
endpoint.logic: - Call supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ phone, token, type: 'sms' }) - Return session on successful verification
- Call supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider, options: { redirectTo } }) - Return OAuth URL for frontend redirect
- Call supabase.auth.signOut() - Invalidate session tokens

endpoint.description: Refresh access token using refresh token
endpoint.logic: - Call supabase.auth.refreshSession({ refresh_token }) - Return new session tokens
- Extract user from JWT token via supabase.auth.getUser() - Fetch full profile from public.users table - Return combined auth and profile data
- Call supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo }) - Supabase sends reset link to email

endpoint.description: Reset password with token from email
endpoint.logic: - Call supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: new_password }) - User must be authenticated via reset link

endpoint.description: Complete user profile after signup (first login)
endpoint.logic: - Update public.users record with additional profile fields - Uses RLS policy - user can only update own profile

sign_in_methods.method: Phone OTP (via Twilio/MessageBird configured in Supabase)

authentication_middleware.name: supabaseAuthMiddleware
authentication_middleware.description: Verify Supabase JWT token and attach user to request
authentication_middleware.logic: - Extract Bearer token from Authorization header - Verify JWT using Supabase client: supabase.auth.getUser(token) - If valid, fetch user profile from public.users using user.id - Attach user object to req.user (includes auth and profile data) - Return 401 if token invalid, expired, or user not found/inactive

optional_auth.name: optionalSupabaseAuth
optional_auth.description: Allow unauthenticated requests but attach user if token exists
optional_auth.logic: - Check for Authorization header - If present and valid, attach user to req.user - If absent or invalid, continue without user (req.user = null)

role_check_middleware.name: roleMiddleware
role_check_middleware.logic: - Check req.user exists (post authMiddleware) - Check req.user.role is in allowed_roles, else return 403

validation_middleware.name: validateRequest
validation_middleware.description: Validate request body/params/query using schemas (Zod or Joi)

layer.name: input_sanitization
layer.description: Clean and sanitize all inputs before validation
layer.actions: - Trim whitespace from strings - Remove HTML tags (prevent XSS) - Normalize phone numbers to E.164 format - Lowercase emails - Escape special characters

layer.name: schema_validation
layer.features: - Type coercion for query params - Custom error messages in Hindi/English - Nested object validation - Array length limits - Regex patterns for phone, email, UUIDs

layer.name: business_rules
layer.rules: - Booking date must be in future - Review can only be submitted after consultation - Reminder date must be before hearing date - Lawyer fee within allowed range

api_security.input_sanitization: - Sanitize all user inputs - RLS prevents unauthorized data access - Parameterized queries used by Supabase client - Prevent XSS attacks - Validate file uploads (type, size, content)

phase1.name: Foundation & Supabase Setup (Week 1-2)
phase1.tasks: - Create Supabase project at app.supabase.com - Initialize Node.js project with Express.js - Setup folder structure (controllers, routes, services, middleware, utils) - Install @supabase/supabase-js client library - Configure Supabase client with environment variables - Create database schema via Supabase SQL Editor or migrations - Enable Row Level Security (RLS) on all tables - Create RLS policies for each table - Create database functions (is_admin, handle_new_user, update_lawyer_rating) - Create database triggers for user creation and rating updates - Setup Express server with CORS, helmet, body-parser - Implement error handling middleware with custom error classes - Setup Pino or Winston logger - Configure environment variables with dotenv - Setup ESLint and Prettier for code quality

phase2.name: Authentication with Supabase Auth (Week 3)
phase2.tasks: - Configure Auth providers in Supabase Dashboard: - Enable Email/Password authentication - Enable Phone OTP (configure Twilio in Auth settings) - Enable Google OAuth (add client ID and secret) - Implement signup endpoint (email + password, phone + OTP) - Implement signin endpoint (password-based) - Implement phone OTP flow (send OTP, verify OTP) - Implement OAuth flow (Google signin) - Implement signout endpoint - Implement token refresh endpoint - Implement /auth/me endpoint to get current user - Implement forgot-password and reset-password flows - Create supabaseAuthMiddleware for JWT verification - Create optionalSupabaseAuth middleware - Implement /auth/complete-profile for additional user data - Test all auth flows end-to-end - Setup rate limiting for auth endpoints (5 req/min)

phase3.name: User & Lawyer Management (Week 4)
phase3.tasks: - Implement GET /user/profile endpoint - Implement PUT /user/profile for profile updates - Create Supabase Storage buckets: - 'lawyer-documents' (private) for bar certificates, ID proofs - 'profile-photos' (public) for profile pictures - Configure storage bucket policies and RLS - Implement StorageService with upload, getPublicUrl, createSignedUrl - Implement file upload endpoints for lawyer documents - Generate signed URLs for private document access - Implement GET /lawyers/search with filters (specialization, city, price, rating) - Implement pagination for lawyer search results - Implement GET /lawyers/:id for detailed lawyer profile - Implement GET /lawyers/:id/availability for time slot generation - Implement lawyer_availability CRUD operations - Implement slot availability checking against existing bookings

phase4.name: Consultation Booking & Payments (Week 5)
phase4.tasks: - Install Razorpay Node.js SDK - Implement PaymentService with createOrder, verifySignature, initiateRefund - Implement POST /consultations/book (validate slot, create Razorpay order) - Implement POST /consultations/:id/confirm-payment with signature verification - Setup Google Calendar API credentials for Meet integration - Implement VideoService.createMeeting() for Google Meet link generation - Auto-generate Meet link on payment confirmation - Implement GET /consultations/my-consultations with status filtering - Implement PUT /consultations/:id/cancel with refund initiation - Implement PUT /consultations/:id/complete (lawyer/admin only) - Setup Supabase Realtime for booking notifications - Implement 24-hour cancellation policy check

phase5.name: Reviews, Cases & Reminders (Week 6)
phase5.tasks: - Implement POST /reviews/create with consultation verification - Enforce one review per consultation (database unique constraint) - Implement GET /reviews/lawyer/:id with pagination - Verify database trigger for automatic rating updates - Implement POST /cases/create for manual case entry - Implement GET /cases/my-cases with status and type filtering - Implement PUT /cases/:id for case updates - Implement DELETE /cases/:id (soft delete with related reminders) - Implement POST /reminders/create with auto-message generation - Implement GET /reminders/my-reminders with status filtering - Implement DELETE /reminders/:id for reminder cancellation - Validate reminder dates are in the future

phase6.name: AI Chatbot with Gemini (Week 7)
phase6.tasks: - Setup Google AI Studio account and generate Gemini API key - Install @google/generative-ai SDK - Implement ChatbotService with processQuery method - Create system prompt for Nyaay Saathi legal assistant persona - Configure safety settings for legal content - Implement multi-turn conversation support with history - Implement POST /chatbot/query with Gemini API integration - Parse Gemini responses to extract intent and confidence - Generate contextual suggestions (Talk to lawyer, Calculate costs, etc.) - Log all interactions to chatbot_interactions table - Implement POST /chatbot/cost-estimate with AI-assisted calculations - Create cost matrix for different case types and cities (tier 1/2/3) - Handle Gemini API rate limits with exponential backoff - Implement fallback responses for API failures - Support bilingual responses (English and Hindi)

phase7.name: Scheduled Jobs & Automation (Week 8)
phase7.tasks: - Enable pg_cron extension in Supabase Dashboard - Create database-level cron jobs using pg_cron for: - Auto-complete past consultations - Create hearing reminders for next day - Setup external cron service (cron-job.org) or Supabase Edge Functions for: - sendPendingReminders (every 5 minutes) - sendConsultationReminders (hourly) - Configure SMS service (Twilio/MSG91) for reminder delivery - Implement job logging and error tracking - Setup Supabase Realtime subscriptions for real-time notifications - Implement RealtimeService for consultation and reminder updates - Test all scheduled jobs in staging environment

phase8.name: Admin Panel APIs (Week 9)
phase8.tasks: - Implement roleMiddleware for admin-only routes - Implement GET /admin/dashboard with aggregated stats - Calculate total users, lawyers, consultations, revenue using Supabase queries - Implement POST /admin/lawyers/create (add new lawyer) - Implement GET /admin/lawyers/pending (unverified lawyers list) - Implement PUT /admin/lawyers/:id/verify (approve/reject) - Document verification workflow with rejection reasons - Implement admin user management (activate/deactivate users) - Implement revenue reports and consultation analytics - Use service_role_key for admin operations that bypass RLS

phase9.name: Testing & Documentation (Week 10)
phase9.tasks: - Setup Jest testing framework with Supertest - Write unit tests for all services (ChatbotService, PaymentService, etc.) - Write unit tests for validators and utility functions - Write integration tests for Supabase Auth flows - Write integration tests for consultation booking flow - Write integration tests for payment verification - Achieve minimum 70% code coverage - Setup Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 documentation at /api/docs - Document all endpoints with request/response examples - Write comprehensive README.md (setup, env vars, deployment) - Perform load testing with Artillery (1000 req/min target) - Validate 95% of requests under 2 seconds response time - Fix performance bottlenecks identified in testing

phase10.name: Production Deployment (Week 11-12)
phase10.tasks: - Upgrade Supabase project to Pro plan for production - Configure production environment variables - Run final database migrations on production Supabase - Verify all RLS policies are active and correct - Deploy Node.js/Express backend to Vercel/Railway/Render - Configure custom domain and SSL for API - Setup GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline: - Run tests on PR - Deploy to staging on merge to develop - Deploy to production on merge to main - Configure Supabase CLI in CI for database migrations - Setup Sentry for error tracking - Configure monitoring and alerting - Perform smoke tests on production - Setup database backups (automatic with Supabase Pro) - Document disaster recovery procedures - Go live and monitor initial traffic

notes.note: Always enable RLS on all tables. Never expose SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to client-side code.
Razorpay signature verification is critical for payment security and must be tested thoroughly.
Use database triggers and functions for automatic data updates (ratings, user creation).
Test RLS policies thoroughly before production deployment.
Keep the MVP scope tight to deliver quickly and iterate based on user feedback.
Supabase provides a unified platform - reduces DevOps complexity significantly.
